description:
Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Data Scientist (Data Visualisation) Overview
- The Mastercard Economics Institute (MEI) is an economics lab powering scale at Mastercard by owning economic thought leadership in support of Mastercard s efforts to build a more inclusive and sustainable digital economy
- The Economics Institute was launched in 2020 to analyze economic trends through the lens of the consumer to deliver tailored and actionable insights on economic issues for customers, partners and policymakers
- The Institute is composed of a team of economists and data scientists that utilize synthesize the anonymized and aggregated data from the Mastercard network together with public data to bring powerful insights to life, in the form of 1:1 presentations, global thought leadership, media participation, and commercial work through the company s product suites
 
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join Mastercard s Economics Institute, reporting to the team lead for Data Systems Engineering. An individual who will: 
- create clear, compelling data visualisations that communicate economic insights to diverse audiences
- develop reusable functions and packages to support analysis and automation
- create and format analytical content using R Markdown and/or Quarto
- write clear, well-documented code that others can understand and maintain
 
 
All About You
 
- passionate about using data visualisations to tell stories
- 1-3 years experience in creating data visualisations
- proficient in R or Python
- proficient in using code to clean data, transform, and aggregate data
- familiar with version control concepts and tools for collaborative development
- experience writing SQL and working with relational databases
- creative and passionate about data, coding, and technology
- strong collaborator who can work independently, prioritise across multiple projects, and work effectively with engineers, product owners, and economists Corporate Security Responsibility 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard s guidelines.

title: Reltio MDM Platform Engineer
description:
Job Description - Reltio MDM Platform Engineer 
 Position: Reltio MDM Platform Engineer
 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Work Mode: Hybrid
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 3 to 6 Years 
 About the Role 
We are looking for an experienced Reltio MDM Platform Engineer to design, develop, configure, and support enterprise Master Data Management solutions using the Reltio MDM platform .
The role will involve working across the MDM data lifecycle, including data ingestion, ETL processing, standardization, data quality, matching, survivorship, integrations, APIs, and Reltio configuration . The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Reltio and good understanding of data engineering concepts, along with the ability to work with business and technical stakeholders.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and develop end-to-end Reltio MDM solutions covering data ingestion, preprocessing, processing, and post-processing. Configure and maintain Reltio MDM entities, attributes, relationships, match rules, survivorship rules, data quality rules, and workflows . Develop and maintain ETL pipelines for loading and processing master data into Reltio. Implement data standardization, cleansing, validation, enrichment, and data quality processes . Develop solutions for delta detection and incremental data processing . Work on Reltio configuration and customization, including L3 configurations . Develop and maintain API-based integrations between Reltio and enterprise applications. Troubleshoot integration issues, data discrepancies, failed jobs, and MDM processing issues. Support data stewardship and Data Change Request (DCR) processes. Work with downstream and upstream systems to ensure reliable master-data synchronization. Analyze and improve match and merge processes and help optimize data matching accuracy. Build monitoring and operational processes for MDM data pipelines and integrations. Collaborate with Data Engineers, Architects, Business Analysts, Data Stewards, and client stakeholders. Participate in requirement gathering, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Create technical documentation including data models, mapping documents, STTMs, technical designs, and process documentation . Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. 
 Required Technical Skills 
 Must Have: 
 3 to 6 years of experience in Reltio MDM / Master Data Management . Hands-on experience with Reltio Cloud MDM . Strong understanding of MDM concepts , including: Data Quality Data Standardization Matching & Merging Survivorship Entity Resolution Data Stewardship Golden Records Experience developing Reltio ETL/data integration pipelines . Experience with Reltio APIs and REST API integrations . Hands-on experience with Reltio configuration . Strong SQL skills. Experience with Python and/or PySpark . Good understanding of data engineering and ETL concepts. Experience working with large datasets and enterprise data platforms. 
 Good to Have 
 Experience with Databricks and PySpark. Experience with Apache Airflow or other workflow orchestration tools. Experience integrating Reltio with CRM/enterprise applications. Experience with DCR / Data Change Request processes. Knowledge of cloud data platforms. Experience with GenAI/LLM-based data matching or entity resolution. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Experience with JIRA and technical documentation. 
 Preferred Profile 
The ideal candidate will be someone who:
 Has strong hands-on Reltio MDM development/configuration experience . Understands the complete MDM data flow from source ETL Reltio stewardship, downstream systems . Can independently troubleshoot data and integration issues. Has strong SQL and data engineering fundamentals. Can work closely with technical teams as well as business/data stewardship stakeholders. Has experience taking ownership of MDM components from requirement through implementation and production support. Education 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent technical experience may also be considered.
